返回的最大数。取值范围：1~500。
默认值：500。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 500.

description.zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next request exists. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken.
The enterprise AD office network ID.

description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
